# Lumia Stream sub-actions

## Chat bot message

Sends a message in chat through Lumia Stream's chat bot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | The text to send. |
| **Platform** | Which chat to send it to, or all for every chat Lumia is connected to. Options: twitch, youtube, facebook, kick, discord, all. Starts as: `twitch`. |
| **Send as the streamer** | Tick to send it as you instead of as the bot. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.chatbotMessage`</small>

## Get variable

Reads one of Lumia Stream's variables and saves its value in a variable of yours.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable** | The Lumia variable to read, like "twitch_username". |
| **Save as argument** | The name of your variable that will hold the answer. Use it later as %name%. Starts as: `lumia.variableValue`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%lumia.variableValue%` | The value read from Lumia (or whatever name you chose in the box above) |

<small>Type id: `lumia.getVariable`</small>

## Send alert

Makes Lumia Stream show one of its alerts, as if it had really happened. Good for a light show on your own events.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alert** | The alert's name, like "twitch-follower" or "twitch-bits". |
| **Extra settings** | Extra details for Lumia, one per line as name=value, like username=%user%. Lumia can use them in its own texts as {{name}}. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.sendAlert`</small>

## Send API request

Sends a raw request to Lumia Stream for things the other steps cannot do. For advanced users who know Lumia's request types.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Type** | The kind of request, as Lumia names it, like "studio-scene" or "clear-queue". |
| **Params (JSON)** | The details of the request, written like {"value":"Sunset"}. Leave empty if it needs none. |
| **Save reply as argument** | The name of your variable that will hold Lumia's reply. Starts as: `lumia.response`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%lumia.response%` | Lumia's reply (or whatever name you chose in the box above) |

<small>Type id: `lumia.send`</small>

## Send command

Tells Lumia Stream to run one of your commands, such as a light show. Handy for stream events.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The command's name, as you set it up in Lumia Stream. |
| **Command type** | Where the command comes from in Lumia, like a chat command or a channel point reward. Options: chat-command, chatbot-command, twitch-points, twitch-extension, kick-points. Starts as: `chat-command`. |
| **Make it the new default state** | Tick to keep this look until you change it, instead of going back to normal afterwards. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Skip queue** | Tick to run right now instead of waiting behind other commands and colours. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Extra settings** | Extra details for Lumia, one per line as name=value, like username=%user%. Lumia can use them in its own texts as {{name}}. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.sendCommand`</small>

## Set colour

Changes your Lumia Stream lights to a colour. Good for a quick flash when something happens.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Colour** | The colour as #RRGGBB, like #FF0000 for red, or as three numbers like "255,0,0". Starts as: `#FF4076`. |
| **Brightness (0-100)** | How bright, from 0 to 100. Leave empty to use Lumia's usual setting (100). |
| **Duration (ms)** | How long the colour stays, in milliseconds (1000 is one second). Leave empty to use Lumia's usual (4000). |
| **Transition (ms)** | How long the fade into the colour takes, in milliseconds. Leave empty to use Lumia's usual (0, instant). |
| **Reset to default instead** | Tick to put the lights back to normal instead. All other colour settings are ignored. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Lights** | Only change these lights: type their names separated by commas. Leave empty for all your lights. |
| **Make it the new default state** | Tick to keep this look until you change it, instead of going back to normal afterwards. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Skip queue** | Tick to run right now instead of waiting behind other commands and colours. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.setColor`</small>

## Set Lumia on/off

Turns Lumia Stream on or off, or flips it to the other state.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips whatever it is now. Options: On, Off, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.setLumiaState`</small>

## Set stream mode

Turns Lumia Stream's stream mode on or off, or flips it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips whatever it is now. Options: On, Off, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.setStreamMode`</small>

## Set to default

Puts your Lumia Stream lights back to their normal look.

<small>Type id: `lumia.setToDefault`</small>

## Set variable

Sets one of Lumia Stream's variables to a value you choose.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable** | The name of the Lumia variable to set. |
| **Value** | The value to put in it. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.setVariable`</small>

## Text to speech

Makes Lumia Stream read a message out loud.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | The text to read out. |
| **Voice** | The voice to use. Leave empty for Lumia's normal voice. |
| **Volume (0-100)** | How loud, from 0 to 100. Only works on Windows. Leave empty for the normal volume. |

<small>Type id: `lumia.tts`</small>
